items.description: Clean affected floors, check washing-machine connection, and replace water-damaged skirting boards
items.rationale: Escape of water from the washing-machine hose is an insured peril under 2.4.2; necessary repair to affected building finishes and investigation/checking are covered under 7.1.1(b) and 7.1.7. Cleaning is indemnified only insofar as it removes residues from affected surfaces (7.1.7(h)); estimate is ordinary localized labour and materials, with no separate deductible or limit specified.

items.description: Moisture measurement and drying of affected utility-room and hallway floors
items.rationale: Necessary moisture measurement and drying before repair are expressly included by 7.1.7(b), limited here to the two affected areas. Estimate reflects a modest drying-unit and labour charge; the policy supplies no specific sub-limit or deductible amount.

items.description: Assessment and drying of moisture-affected framed decorative print
items.rationale: Although movable contents are generally not insured under 4.3(d), 5.2.6 specifically covers specialist assessment and conservation of an affected item of particular value, subject to EUR 1,000 exclusive of VAT per item when not individually scheduled. The print is described as an ordinary store-bought decorative print rather than an item of particular value, so this special cost cover is unlikely to apply; the positive amount is a fallback estimate if it qualifies, below the applicable cap.
